name: deploy_all_attachments
desc: If set to true, do a deployment of all attachments in this resource. This parameter cannot be true if either `deploy_attachments` inside any `network` or `deploy_this_attachment` in any `attachments` is set to true. __Note: Changing value from `true` to `false`, to undo a deployment is not supported__

name: networks[*].arp_suppression
desc: ARP suppression is only supported if SVI is present when Layer-2-Only is not enabled. NX-OS Specific.

name: networks[*].attachments
desc: List of switches attached to the net

name: networks[*].attachments[*].deploy_this_attachment
desc: If set to `true`, deploys this attachment. This cannot be set to `true` if `deploy_all_attachments` at resource level is set to `true` or `deploy_attachments` in the corresponding `network` is set to `true`. __Note: Changing value from `true` to `false`, to undo a deployment is not supported__

name: networks[*].attachments[*].fabric
desc: The name of the child fabric this attachment is present in, only applicable when global fabric name is MSD parent fabric, otherwise this field should remain empty.

name: networks[*].attachments[*].freeform_config
desc: This field covers any configuration not included in overlay templates which is needed as part of this VRF attachment

name: networks[*].deploy_attachments
desc: If set to `true`, deploys all attachments in the network. This parameter cannot be `true` if `deploy_all_attachments` at resource level is set to `true` or `deploy_this_attachment` in any `attachments` is set to `true`. __Note: Changing value from `true` to `false`, to undo a deployment is not supported__

name: networks[*].dhcp_relay_loopback_id
desc: Loopback ID for DHCP Relay interface

name: networks[*].dhcp_relay_servers[*].vrf
desc: Server VRF. If management vrf, enter 'management'. If default/global vrf, enter 'default'.

name: networks[*].display_name
desc: Customized name of the network. By default, it will be same as the network name

name: networks[*].ingress_replication
desc: Ingress replication flag. Read-only per network, Fabric-wide setting.

name: networks[*].netflow
desc: Netflow enable flag. Netflow is supported only if it is enabled on fabric. For NX-OS only.

name: networks[*].network_extension_template
desc: The name of the network extension template. Applicable to Switch(es) with role Border

name: networks[*].network_template
desc: The name of the network template. This is only applicable for leaf switches

name: networks[*].primary_network_id
desc: Primary network VNI ID. This is applicable only when PVLAN is enabled in fabric.

name: networks[*].route_target_both
desc: L2 VNI Route-Target Both Enable. NX-OS specific.

name: networks[*].svi_netflow_monitor
desc: Interface Vlan Netflow Monitor. Applicable only if 'Layer 2 Only' is not enabled. Provide monitor name defined in fabric setting for Layer 3 Record. For NX-OS only.

name: networks[*].vlan_name
desc: Vlan name. If > 32 chars, enable 'system vlan long-name' for NX-OS, disable VTPv1 and VTPv2 or switch to VTPv3 for IOS XE.

name: networks[*].vlan_netflow_monitor
desc: Vlan Netflow Monitor. Provide monitor name defined in fabric setting for Layer 3 Record. For NX-OS only
